meta.description: Companion data file for the Operation Lingua Project Specification. Contains onboarding configuration, gamification tables, the SRS engine parameters, and fully-authored curriculum content for a reference Mission Arc. Import this file as the single source of truth for app content.

operational_personas.label: Corporate Diplomat
operational_personas.description: Business meetings, negotiation register, professional small talk.

clearance_levels.can_do_summary: Can use a handful of rehearsed, memorized phrases for immediate needs.
Can maintain simple face-to-face exchanges on familiar topics; frequent errors but gets basic meaning across.
Wider range of survival topics with more consistency, still leans on familiar patterns.
Can satisfy routine social demands and limited work requirements; gets the gist of most everyday conversation.
Handles most everyday and some work situations with confidence, still needs help with complications.
Professional working proficiency — the FSI graduation bar. Typically requires ongoing practice beyond a single app cycle to reach.

handler_persona.name: ECHO
handler_persona.personality: Seasoned, dryly witty field handler. Warm and encouraging, never condescending, never cutesy.
handler_persona.language_boundary: Speaks the target language during active lesson content once a language is chosen. Speaks the learner's own language for onboarding narration, notifications, and settings/app-chrome text.

content_generation_prompt_template: You are a content designer for Operation Lingua, an FSI/DLI-style immersive language app. Generate ONE Mission Day of content for [LANGUAGE], Arc [ARC_NUMBER] ([ARC_THEME]), Day [DAY_NUMBER], that conforms EXACTLY to the JSON schema used in Operation_Lingua_Content_Data.json under curriculum.spanish.arc_1_arrival_and_survival.day_1 (same keys, same nesting, same field names). Requirements: (1) 8-15 new_items building only on vocabulary already introduced in earlier days of this arc, (2) 2-3 pattern_drills with a base_example plus 3-4 substitutions each, (3) 4-6 tts_multiple_choice items, mixing 'contextual_response' (options must be answerable using ONLY vocabulary already taught up to and including this day) and 'listening_identification' types, each with exactly 4 target-language options and a correct_option_id, (4) 2-3 shadowing_drills, (5) 2-3 speech_to_speech items with scenario_context, ai_character, expected_answers, evaluation_rubric, and both an on_success and on_struggle branch, (6) 1-2 dictation items, (7) a checkpoint_quiz block using the same sampled-composition pattern as existing days. Do not introduce any grammar explanations or English-language instructional text inside the content itself — only target-language content plus English translation fields. Return valid JSON only, matching the schema exactly.
